name: City Council Meeting Agenda
agenda_text:
KELLY HONIG  SUSAN McSWEENEY  BRAD HALPERN  RAY PEARL  NED E DAVIS
  Mayor  Mayor Pro Tem  Councilmember  Councilmember  Councilmember

  AGENDA
  Regular Meeting of the City Council
  CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE
  City Council Chambers
  31200 Oak Crest Drive
  Westlake Village, CA 91361

  WEDNESDAY, May 14, 2025 - 6:30 p.m.
  .

  ATTEND OR WATCH THE MEETING
  Members of the public may attend in-person in the Council Chambers or watch the meeting
  through Zoom, City Website (Live Stream) or Cable TV Channel 10. City Council Chamber doors
  open 30 minutes before the meeting start time.

  PUBLIC COMMENT/SPEAKERS
  Members of the public may express comments to the City Council in person at the meeting or
  may submit written comments before or at the meeting. Submit a Public Speaker card or Written
  Comment card to the City Clerk prior to the public comment portion of that item. Public speakers
  are limited to three minutes unless the presiding officer sets a different limit for meeting
  management purposes. An oral summary of written comments may be given at the discretion of
  the presiding officer.

  Written comments may be emailed to the City Clerk's Office at cityclerk@wlv.org no later than
  4:00 p.m. on the meeting date. Written comments will be provided to City Council prior to the
  meeting and posted at https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-Packets

  ZOOM VIEWING ONLY:
  Members of the public watching through Zoom will not have the ability to provide comments on
  agenda items. Zoom is offered strictly as an additional viewing platform. To provide comments,
  see Public Comments/Speakers section.

  https://us02web.zoom.us/j/81330233596
  Webinar ID: 813 3023 3596
  One Tap Mobile:
  +16694449171,,81330233596# OR 16699009128,,81330233596#
  Telephone:
  +1 669 444 9171 OR +1 669 900 9128 OR +1 253 205 0468
 Unless the City Council holds a teleconference meeting under AB 2449 (2022) guidelines, the
meeting will not be cancelled if technical issues occur.

In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related
modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or
services, please call the City Clerk’s office at (818) 706-1613 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

Any disclosable public records related to an open session item on a regular meeting agenda and
distributed by the City to the City Council less than 72 hours prior to that meeting are available for
public inspection at City Hall (31200 Oak Crest Drive, Westlake Village) during normal business
hours and are posted on the City’s Website - https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-
Packets.

CALL TO ORDER: 6:30 p.m.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE:

ROLL CALL:  Councilmembers Davis, Pearl,  Halpern,  Mayor  Pro  Tem
  McSweeney, Mayor Honig

APPROVAL OF AGENDA:

APPROVAL OF MINUTES:

Minutes of April 23, 2025 Closed Session and City Council Regular Meeting.

SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS/CEREMONIAL MATTERS:

  1. City to Schools Program - White Oak Elementary School 4th Grade Students
  – Student Councilmembers and City Manager

  2. 2024 Recycling All-Star Award presented by WM and the City of Westlake
  Village to White Oak Elementary School

  3. Public Works Week Proclamation

PUBLIC COMMENTS:
Members of the public may address the City Council on non-agenda items that are within the Council’s
subject matter jurisdiction. Please observe the time limit (three minutes unless a different limit is set by the
presiding officer for meeting management purposes). Public Comments may be presented via a written
comment, see Page 1 for deadline. Complete a Speaker Card and submit it to the City Clerk to be called
to speak while in the Council Chambers.

COUNCIL RESPONSE:

STAFF COMMENTS:

COUNCIL COMMENTS:

CITY COUNCIL COMMITTEE REPORTS: Reports on City Council Committee meetings held.
 RECESS:

Recess for White Oak Elementary Students departure. Refreshments served outside.

PUBLIC HEARINGS:

  1. CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT NO. 10-004 – MODIFICATION NO. 3
  (RESOLUTION NO. 2402-25); LAS VIRGENES UNIFIED SCHOOL DISTRICT
  LEASE TERMINATION; MONTESSORI OF THE VILLAGE, INC. LEASE
  APPROVAL - (1) Adopt Resolution No. 2402-25, determining Modification No. 3
  of Conditional Use Permit No. 10-004 is exempt from CEQA and authorizing the
  continued operation of a pre-school and childcare facility located at 30798
  Russell Ranch Road; (2) approve the Lease Termination and Sale of Portables
  Agreement with the Las Virgenes Unified School District; and (3) approve the
  Lease with Montessori of the Village.

  RESOLUTION NO. 2402-25: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE
  CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE APPROVING MODIFICATION NO. 3 OF
  CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT NO. 10-004 FOR A TIME EXTENSION
  AUTHORIZING THE CONTINUED OPERATION OF A PRE-SCHOOL AND
  CHILDCARE FACILITY LOCATED AT 30798 RUSSELL RANCH ROAD

  2. CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT NO. 14-016, MODIFICATION NO. 2;
  RESOLUTION NO. 2403-25 - Adopt Resolution No. 2403-25, determining
  Modification No. 2 of Conditional Use Permit No. 14-016 is exempt from CEQA
  and authorizing a time extension for the continued sale of beer and wine for on-
  site consumption at an existing restaurant located at 30734 Russell Ranch Roal,
  Suite D.

  RESOLUTION NO. 2403-25: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL
  OF THE CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE APPROVING MODIFICATION NO. 2 OF
  CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT NO. 14-016, TO AUTHORIZE A TIME EXTENSION
  FOR THE CONTINUED SALE OF BEER AND WINE FOR ON-SITE
  CONSUMPTION FOR BOARD & BREW RESTAURANT LOCATED AT 30734
  RUSSELL RANCH ROAD, SUITE D

CONSENT CALENDAR: Matters listed under the Consent Calendar are considered to be routine and
will be enacted by one motion and one vote. Unless otherwise requested by a Councilmember, there will
be no separate discussion of these items. If discussion is desired, that item will be removed from the
Consent Calendar and will be considered separately.

  APPROVAL OF WARRANTS: Warrants effective May 1, 2025 in the amount of
  $1,592,402.26

  TREASURER’S REPORT:
   GENERAL BUSINESS:

  1. AMENDMENT NO. 1 OF LANDSCAPE MAINTENANCE SERVICE
  CONTRACTS TO AMERICAN HERITAGE LANDSCAPE AND BRIGHTVIEW
  LANDSCAPE SERVICES - Approve Amendment No. 1 to the Citywide
  landscape maintenance services contract to American Heritage, in the amount
  of $1,448,024.40 for the purpose of city-wide landscape maintenance services
  and Amendment No. 1 to the Community landscape maintenance and janitorial
  services contract with Brightview, in the amount of $621,648.00 for landscape
  maintenance and janitorial services at the Community Park and authorize the
  Mayor to execute the contracts on behalf of the City.

  2. ADOPTION OF ORDINANCE NO 307-25. ORDINANCE TITLE: AN
  ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE AMENDING THE
  WESTLAKE VILLAGE MUNICIPAL CODE CHAPTER 9.2 SECTION 9.2.020,
  CHAPTER 9.5 SECTION 9.5.030 AND REGULATIONS TABLE, CHAPTER 9.6
  SECTION 9.6.030, SECTION 9.6.040 AND REGULATIONS TABLE, AND
  ADDING CHAPTER 9.46 TO ADD RESIDENTIAL CARE FACILITY
  REGULATIONS AND APPROVING A CEQA EXEMPTION DETERMINATION
  - Waive the second reading and adopt Ordinance No. 307-25.

  ORDINANCE NO. 307-25: AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF WESTLAKE
  VILLAGE AMENDING THE WESTLAKE VILLAGE MUNICIPAL CODE
  CHAPTER 9.2 SECTION 9.2.020, CHAPTER 9.5 SECTION 9.5.030 AND
  REGULATIONS TABLE, CHAPTER 9.6 SECTION 9.6.030, SECTION 9.6.040
  AND REGULATIONS TABLE, AND ADDING CHAPTER 9.46 TO ADD
  RESIDENTIAL CARE FACILITY REGULATIONS AND APPROVING A CEQA
  EXEMPTION DETERMINATION

OLD BUSINESS:

NEW BUSINESS:

  1. PROPOSED TRAFFIC STRIPING AND SIGNING ON VIA ROCAS - Approve
  implementation of bike lane and edge-line striping and signing along Via Rocas.

  2. ADOPTION OF PLANS AND SPECIFICATIONS, CEQA EXEMPTION
  DETERMINATION, AND AUTHORIZATION TO ADVERTISE BIDS FOR
  COMMUNITY PARK PARKING LOT SEAL COAT PROJECT - Determine that
  the Community Park Seal Coat Project is exempt from CEQA, adopt the plans and
  specifications for the Community Park Seal Coat Project and authorize staff to
  advertise bids for the Community Park Seal Coat Project.

ADJOURNMENT:

This agenda was posted on Thursday, May 8, 2025 at 5:00 p.m. on the City’s website and in the
Posting Board at City Hall.

  Carol Kramer
  Deputy City Clerk
